title: feat(plugin-auth): registerOrganizationRecordPage: false leaves out sys_organization_detail for a host that ships its own default record page
body:
Fixes #23254
Clause-②: yes (a new declared `AuthPluginOptions` key; the default is unchanged)

## What this does

Ruling A on #23015 (record `6134056653`) allows one `isDefault: true` record page per object per deployment, and keeps one page "by overlay-by-name or by composition". The cloud seat measured that overlay-by-name does not reach the organization page. This PR is the composition route.

`AuthPlugin` gains one declared option, `registerOrganizationRecordPage` (default `true`). With an explicit `false`, `plugin-auth` does not register `sys_organization_detail` (`SysOrganizationDetailPage`), so a host that ships its own default record page for `sys_organization` is the single default by construction.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: the option on `AuthPluginOptions`, with a docblock that states what it removes and what stays. The page list in `init()` reads it; `SysUserDetailPage` registers either way. When the page is left out, `init()` logs one `info` line naming the option ("absence must be loud").
- ⛔ No precedence ladder and ⛔ no registration-order rule. The default is unchanged. The one-default refusal from PR #23206 is untouched.
- Cloud's half (setting the option, retiring its order-pinning test) is objectstack-ai/cloud#2773's, not this PR's.

## Option name and shape (H1)

The option is named `registerOrganizationRecordPage`, a boolean whose `true` keeps today's behaviour. It follows `registerRoutes?: boolean` (`@default true`) on the same interface.

- **It names what the runtime does, not a claim about the host.** The alternative was a host declaration in the shape of `hostSignInHandoff` (for example `hostOrganizationRecordPage: true`). That spelling would assert a fact the runtime never checks. This one says exactly what `plugin-auth` does with it, and the pins prove it, so declared is enforced.
- **Only an explicit `false` removes the page.** The read is `!== false`, not a constructor default. A constructor default spread under the caller's options would let an explicit `undefined` override it and silently drop the page.
- **One boolean, not a page list.** No caller needs to leave out any other page (`sys_user_detail` has one default). A general list option would be capability with no pull behind it.

## Where else the organization page is wired (H2)

Measured at `6c181625f`, re-read on the merged head:

| place | reads `sys_organization_detail` how | made false by the option? |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts` and `identity-objects-plugin.ts` | no page list (objects only) | no; untouched |
| `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.ts` | `pages.sys_organization_detail.label`, a bundle entry looked up by page name | no. An entry for a page that is not registered is never read. The host ships its own page's translations. |
| `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs`, `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`, `scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs` | static, over the `@objectstack/platform-objects/pages` barrel and source | no. The page still ships in the barrel, and none of them boots a host that sets the option. |
| navigation / apps | none: no nav item or app names the page. Record pages are found by `object` plus `isDefault`, never by name. | nothing dangles |
| objectui `7578323` | named only in `useNavigationSync` tests and a comment, as an example of a `sys_` name | no |

Nothing else needed changing.

## Pins (H3): `organization-record-page-option.test.ts`

The harness is a real `ObjectKernel`, a real ObjectQL engine on in-memory SQLite (the shape this package's other kernel tests boot), the real `AuthPlugin` from source, and a host plugin that registers its own `sys_organization` default record page through the `manifest` service, as `AppPlugin.init()` does. The refusal is the registry's own, reached through that door. The "single default" reading uses `@objectstack/spec/ui`'s `defaultRecordPageObject`, the same reading the refusal uses.

1. **With the option, the host's page is the single default and the boot succeeds, in either plugin order.** `sys_organization`'s defaults are exactly `[host_organization_detail of com.example.host-tenant]`, and `sys_user_detail` is unchanged. Control: pin 3, the same composition without the option, is refused.
2. **Without it, `plugin-auth`'s page registers as today.** The defaults are exactly `[sys_organization_detail of com.objectstack.plugin-auth]`. Control: the option with no host page leaves `sys_organization` with no default at all, so the reading is not vacuous.
3. **With both pages and no option, `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` still refuses, in either order.** The test asserts `code` + `status` (`422`), `object`, and the `incoming` / `existing` pair. Control: an explicit `true` is refused the same way.

**Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, under `os-verify-lock`): the conditional was made to ignore the option (anchor `pages: [...(registerOrganizationRecordPage ? [SysOrganizationDetailPage] : []), SysUserDetailPage],` replaced with `pages: [SysOrganizationDetailPage, SysUserDetailPage],`). The tool reported anchor x1 to x0 and blob `72c5e5482b2a` to `8195f6d48184`. Result: **pin 1 red** (`auth first: the boot succeeds: expected DefaultRecordPageConflictError ... to be undefined`), pin 2's control red (`expected [ {...} ] to deeply equal []`), pin 3 green. 2 failed, 1 passed. Restore: blob after restore `72c5e5482b2a` equals the blob at HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. AuthPlugin is imported from source (relative), so no `dist/` leg applies.

All 68 ran with each exit code captured before any pipe: **68 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

## Acceptance notes

- The refusal's message still says "compose the deployment without the package that ships the other". The option is a narrower form of that remedy, and the message is unchanged on purpose (no change to PR #23206's refusal).
- `pages.sys_organization_detail.label` stays in the platform bundles. It is read only when the page is registered, and the default composition still registers it.
- The new test file's wall time is dominated by module import (the AuthPlugin chain), the same as this package's other real-kernel tests. Its three tests took 1.23 s in total, on a shared box.
